does: Builds a condition context from a source and a target entity, their two positions, a HitDesc and an AttackDesc, a status event and a status id: source at +0x0, target at +0x10, positions at +0x40 and +0x4C, the HitDesc pointer at +0x68, the AttackDesc pointer at +0xC8, the status event at +0xD0, the status FixedString at +0xD4; every other entity slot empty.

evidence.says: writes its first two handle arguments at +0x0 and +0x10, copies two vec3 to +0x40 and +0x4C, stores pointers at +0x68 and +0xC8 and adds a reference to the FixedString it stores at +0xD4; unplaced::EvaluateStatusCondition calls it with the status's StatusCause and Target
the overload ContextData(EntityHandle, EntityHandle, Vector3f, Vector3f, HitDesc&, AttackDesc&, EStatusEvent, ...) of the builds with symbols has this argument list

questions.ask: Watch the constructor itself with a probe (Return = true, a 64-byte snapshot of argument 1 on return) during HOLD_PERSON's repeat save to see the fields filled.
